Farm to Home

Avishkarna Andhra Internship Mini Project

A full-stack e-commerce web application connecting local farmers directly with consumers.

Use Left and Right arrow keys to navigate

Problem Statement & Objective

  • The Problem: Farmers often struggle with middlemen reducing their profits, while consumers face a lack of transparency and direct access to high-quality, fresh agricultural produce.
  • The Objective: To develop a direct-to-consumer digital marketplace that eliminates middlemen, ensures fair pricing for farmers, and provides consumers with an easy way to purchase fresh, organic produce straight from the source.

App Features: Consumer (Buyer)

  • Smart Marketplace: Browse, filter, and search for fresh produce by category.
  • FarmPass Subscriptions: Premium membership for zero delivery fees and exclusive discounts.
  • Real-Time Direct Chat: Communicate directly with farmers about produce freshness via Socket.io.
  • Dynamic Checkout: Multi-step checkout with real-time cart subtotal and delivery calculations.

App Features: Farmer (Seller)

  • Dedicated Dashboard: High-level overview of total earnings, pending orders, and product count.
  • Inventory Management: Full CRUD capabilities to manage products, pricing, and stock.
  • Order Processing System: Seamlessly update order fulfillment status (Pending → Processing → Delivered).
  • Profile Management: Build trust by maintaining a public profile showcasing farming practices.

Tech Stack & Architecture

  • Frontend: React.js & Vite with responsive, Mobile-First Custom Vanilla CSS.
  • Backend: Node.js & Express.js (RESTful APIs).
  • Database: MongoDB & Mongoose.
  • Authentication: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
  • Real-Time & Cloud: Socket.io for live chat and Cloudinary for secure, scalable image uploads.

Methodology / How We Built It

  • Phase 1 (Design): Created the UI/UX with a mobile-first approach and designed the MongoDB schemas for Users, Products, and Orders.
  • Phase 2 (Backend): Developed secure RESTful APIs, set up JWT-based dual-role authentication, and configured Cloudinary for media.
  • Phase 3 (Frontend): Built responsive React components, integrated state management, and connected to backend endpoints.
  • Phase 4 (Advanced Integration): Deployed WebSocket (Socket.io) for real-time messaging and implemented the dynamic FarmPass subscription logic.

Challenges & Future Scope

  • Challenges Faced:
    • Strict Dual-Role Access Control and routing (Farmer vs Consumer).
    • Managing real-time WebSocket state connections cleanly on the frontend.
    • Designing a highly responsive UI without relying on heavy CSS frameworks.
  • Future Scope:
    • Integration of external payment gateways (Stripe/Razorpay).
    • AI-driven price prediction and demand forecasting.
    • Logistics and third-party delivery partner integration.

1. Home Page

Explanation: The welcoming storefront featuring a modern hero-banner. Highlights the core value proposition and displays featured products to immediately engage users.

2. Products Marketplace

Explanation: The primary shopping interface for consumers. Presents a responsive grid layout of fresh produce with filtering by category and search functionality.

3. Secure Authentication

Explanation: A dual-role authentication portal where users specify if they are a "Consumer" or "Farmer". Powered by JWT token encryption ensuring data security.

4. Farmer Dashboard

Explanation: A secure management panel for verified farmers to track earnings, fulfill orders, and seamlessly manage product inventory.

5. FarmPass & Subscriptions

Explanation: A dedicated section allowing users to manage premium features like FarmPass for zero delivery fees and recurring essential deliveries.

6. Dynamic Cart & Checkout

Explanation: A seamless shopping cart that automatically calculates subtotals, applies FarmPass discounts, and computes delivery fees before checkout.

7. Real-Time Chat

Explanation: A Socket.io-powered messaging system enabling direct communication between consumers and farmers to ask about product freshness or delivery.
